---
title: "Draft: load metabolomics pipeline outputs into the GLAMR Postgres warehouse"
---

**This is a draft, not a live loader.** Not run against the real
`glamr_data` database from this dev sandbox - copy into GLAMR's real
`code/postgres.Rmd` and adapt. Follows the existing file's ETL idiom
throughout: `get_pg_table_samples()` to find already-loaded samples,
`Sys.glob()` + `unglue::unglue_unnest()` to parse sample IDs out of file
paths, `dbWriteTable(append = TRUE)`, then manual `CREATE INDEX`.

## Tables

Three new tables, one per pipeline output type. Kept separate rather than
one wide table because feature-level, abundance-level, and annotation-level
data have different natural keys (`feature_id` alone; `feature_id` x
`sample`; `feature_id` x `annotation_source`) and different growth rates.

```{r}
pg <- DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), dbname = "glamr_data",
                     host = "cayman.earth.lsa.umich.edu", port = "5432",
                     user = "glamr_admin", password = "glamr2023")
```

### `metabolite_features` - one row per aligned feature per processing group

From `data/projects/{dataset}/metabolomics/{group_id}/qc/feature_table_filtered.tsv`
(post blank-filter/precision-filter, per `pipelines/metabolomics.smk` rule
`metab_feature_qc`). MZmine's own columns (confirmed against a real feature
table produced in this dev sandbox - 2073 features x 6 samples): `id`, `mz`,
`rt`, plus per-sample `datafile:{sample}.mzML:area` /`:height`/`:rt`/`:mz`/
etc. This loader keeps only the feature-level (non-per-sample) columns; the
per-sample values go to `metabolite_feature_abund` instead, in long form,
so it joins directly against the existing `gene_abundance` /
`contig_abund` tables the way the plan's "cross-omics linking" section
describes.

```{r}
feature_files <- Sys.glob(
  "data/projects/*/metabolomics/*/qc/feature_table_filtered.tsv"
) %>%
  data.frame(path = .) %>%
  unglue_unnest(
    path,
    "data/projects/{dataset}/metabolomics/{group_id}/qc/feature_table_filtered.tsv",
    remove = FALSE
  )

already_loaded <- get_pg_table_samples(pg, "metabolite_features", key = "dataset_group")

new_feature_files <- feature_files %>%
  filter(!paste(dataset, group_id) %in% already_loaded)

metabolite_features <- new_feature_files %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(data = list(read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  select(dataset, group_id, id, mz, rt) %>%
  rename(feature_id = id)

dbWriteTable(pg, "metabolite_features", metabolite_features, append = TRUE)
dbExecute(pg, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metabolite_features_id
                ON metabolite_features (dataset, group_id, feature_id)")
```

### `metabolite_feature_abund` - long form, one row per feature per sample

```{r}
metabolite_feature_abund <- new_feature_files %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(data = list(read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  rename(feature_id = id) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^datafile:.*\\.mzML:(area|height)$"),
    names_to = c("sample", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^datafile:(.*)\\.mzML:(area|height)$"
  ) %>%
  select(dataset, group_id, feature_id, sample, area, height)

dbWriteTable(pg, "metabolite_feature_abund", metabolite_feature_abund, append = TRUE)
dbExecute(pg, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metabolite_feature_abund_sample
                ON metabolite_feature_abund (sample)")
dbExecute(pg, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metabolite_feature_abund_feature
                ON metabolite_feature_abund (dataset, group_id, feature_id)")
```

### `metabolite_annotations` - one row per feature per annotation source

Unions MS2Query (`.../ms2query/results.csv`: `feature_id`, added by
`code/ms2query_annotate.py`, then upstream's `ms2query_model_prediction`,
precursor m/z difference and library metadata, one row per MS2 spectrum) and, when `run_sirius` is enabled, SIRIUS's
`structure_identifications.tsv`. Kept in one table with an
`annotation_source` discriminator rather than two, since both ultimately
answer the same question ("what compound might this feature be") and
downstream queries usually want both regardless of which engine produced
them.

```{r}
ms2query_files <- Sys.glob("data/projects/*/metabolomics/*/ms2query/results.csv") %>%
  data.frame(path = .) %>%
  unglue_unnest(
    path,
    "data/projects/{dataset}/metabolomics/{group_id}/ms2query/results.csv",
    remove = FALSE
  )

ms2query_annotations <- ms2query_files %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(data = list(read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  mutate(annotation_source = "ms2query") %>%
  select(dataset, group_id, annotation_source, everything())

sirius_files <- Sys.glob(
  "data/projects/*/metabolomics/*/sirius/summaries/structure_identifications.tsv"
)
sirius_annotations <- if (length(sirius_files) > 0) {
  data.frame(path = sirius_files) %>%
    unglue_unnest(
      path,
      "data/projects/{dataset}/metabolomics/{group_id}/sirius/summaries/structure_identifications.tsv",
      remove = FALSE
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(data = list(read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    unnest(data) %>%
    mutate(annotation_source = "sirius") %>%
    select(dataset, group_id, annotation_source, everything())
} else {
  NULL
}

metabolite_annotations <- bind_rows(ms2query_annotations, sirius_annotations)

dbWriteTable(pg, "metabolite_annotations", metabolite_annotations, append = TRUE)
dbExecute(pg, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metabolite_annotations_source
                ON metabolite_annotations (annotation_source)")
```

## Note on cross-omics joins

`metabolite_feature_abund.sample` is a `samp_*` metabolome ID, not a
`bios_*` BioSample - joining to `gene_abundance`/`kofam_scan_signif_anvio`
requires resolving `samp_*` (metabolome) -> `bios_*` -> `samp_*`
(metagenome), which the plan's "Cross-omics linking (deferred)" section
flags as blocked on a USGS/GLERL crosswalk (`GLR_ID-*` appears nowhere in
`Great_Lakes_Omics_Datasets.xlsx`), not on anything in this loader.
